name: billiardbuddy-computer-use
description: Control local desktop apps through BilliardBuddy Computer Use. Prefer purpose-built connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

interface.shortDescription: Control local desktop apps through BilliardBuddy
interface.longDescription: BilliardBuddy Computer Use lets the agent interact with local apps that you choose to allow. It may use visual information while working. You stay in control: you choose which apps can be accessed and can stop actions at any time.
defaultPrompt: Help me use an app on my computer.
